instruction: Add centroid(G) to networkx's tree distance measures (networkx/algorithms/tree/distance_measures.py, available as nx.tree.centroid): the centroid of an unweighted tree, the node or nodes whose removal leaves no subtree with more than N/2 of the tree's N nodes. It has one node, or two adjacent nodes when removing the edge between them leaves two halves of exactly N/2. Return a list; with two nodes, the one nearer to the first node of G comes first (for nx.full_rary_tree(2, 8) the result is [0, 1], for nx.path_graph(4) it is [1, 2]). It runs in linear time and can differ from the tree center: for nx.star_graph(6) with the path 6-7-8-9-10 added, the centroid is [0] while the center is [7]. A graph that isn't a tree raises nx.NotATree (message containing 'not a tree'), an empty graph raises nx.NetworkXPointlessConcept, and a directed graph raises NetworkXNotImplemented. Add tests.
notes: Plan item 8 labelling batch (October 6, 2026): mined from a tuning repository to label which settings miss; not in the 29-task tuning comparisons or the long-session sequences. Tuning only.
